proposal.observation: detected_lines.png: all 10 vertical ring joints (magenta) are found at a uniform ~245 px pitch, consistent with ring_count_error=0. However, oblique joint lines (green at y~1450-1480, red at y~1620-1640) are only recovered for x>~1000, i.e. the right ~6 rings; the left ~4 rings have no oblique lines at all, and short blue horizontal fallback segments fire at y~800 and y~2300. The outlier map shows the circumferential joint rows as sparse dotted traces on the left half and denser traces on the right, so the joints exist across the full width but are too fragmented for the current Hough settings. initial_prompt_points.png shows all 10 centres tagged 'propagated' at a single y (~1545), meaning prompt centres for the left rings are extrapolated from the right-side pattern rather than detected. depth_map_viridis.png shows NaN bands along the circumferential joints (top ~y80-130, middle ~y500, lower ~y700-800 of the thumbnail) and along the left edge, consistent with depth_nan_ratio=0.18; the ring joints are straight and evenly spaced, so unrolling distortion is not the visible defect. segmentation_results.png shows a plausible K/B/A band layout and 10 ring instances, but with reduced coverage (sam_fill_rate=0.597). Weakest proxy term is correspondence_f1@15=0.302 (chamfer_sym_px=82), i.e. predicted block boundaries sit far from detected edges, which is what propagated (not detected) prompt centres on the left rings would produce.
proposal.rule: d7 (stage_4_detection): m_line_yield low AND horizontal fallback triggered -> f_missing_lines. Downstream chain per inter_stage_dependencies: f_missing_lines -> unstable/propagated prompt centres -> stage_5 f_crop_offset (masks shifted relative to true joints), which depresses correspondence_f1@15 and sam_fill_rate while leaving ring count intact.
proposal.failure_mode: stage_4_detection.f_missing_lines (too few oblique lines on the left ~40% of the map; horizontal fallback engaged; prompt centres propagated instead of detected), with secondary stage_5_segmentation.f_crop_offset.
proposal.rationale: Remediation r_relax_hough: lower the oblique HoughLinesP accumulator threshold and raise maxLineGap so the sparse dotted joint traces on the left rings link into oblique segments within the fixed [5,10] deg angle window, producing per-ring detected intersections instead of propagated ones. Precondition check: upstream f_depth_holes is present but confined to joint bands and the left edge (nan 0.18, retained_ratio 0.73), and joint contrast is visible across the full width in the outlier map, so the joints are not missing upstream; they are under-linked at detection. The bolt-hole grid runs horizontally (~0 deg) and is rejected by the oblique angle filter, limiting f_spurious_lines risk from relaxing the threshold. All three worked examples raised hough_threshold_oblique to 49-58 as part of large joint overlays that also moved unfolding, denoising and SAM parameters, and all three degraded the proxy (notably sam_fill_rate collapsed in every case); those joint outcomes cannot be attributed per-parameter, so this proposal deliberately holds unfolding (residual 24 cm but orient_agreement 0.9995 and visibly straight joints; not the observed defect), denoising, enhancing and SAM fixed, and moves only the two detection knobs that r_relax_hough names, in the opposite direction to the examples. Values are inside configs/bounds/continuous.json: hough_threshold_oblique 30 in [20,60], maxLineGap_oblique 45 in [10,60]. Expected response: oblique lines appear on the left rings, prompt centres become detected rather than propagated, correspondence_f1@15 and sam_fill_rate rise, ring_count_error stays 0, depth_nan_ratio unchanged (stages 1-3 untouched).
